suite.name: gemma4-e2b-cpu-sapphire-rapids
suite.description: Gemma 4 E2B on x86 Sapphire Rapids CPU (Intel Xeon Platinum 8481C, Socket 0): OpenXLA (YNNPACK), LiteRT-LM (with YNNPACK and XNNPACK), llama.cpp (AVX-512 + AMX), OpenVINO GenAI, and ONNX Runtime GenAI across FP32, BF16, INT8, and INT4/INT2 model precisions. Frameworks are only benchmarked on data types where pre-built model artifacts exist (e.g., llama.cpp is omitted from FP32 because no pre-built F32 GGUF is published in ggml-org/gemma-4-E2B-it-GGUF).
